comparison.objective: Type a case-sensitive word on a keyboard, versus commission a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential 2.5 mm key presses over a keyboard versus hex-key engagement, collar grasping, bimanual stabilization, torque control, and impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Exact text “RoboCurve” earns full credit with character-based partial credit; candidate requires two safe physical stops and no prohibited state manipulation or damage.
comparison.reason: Key sequencing and damper commissioning are plainly different abilities despite both involving small controls.
